} while (0)

#define GET_FIELD(reg, name, field)                     \ /* <=== hw/net/pcnet.c:242:243:GET_FIELD:3 */ 
  (((reg) & name ## _ ## field ## _MASK) >> name ## _ ## field ## _SH)

#define SET_FIELD(regp, name, field, value)             \ /* <=== hw/net/pcnet.c:238:240:SET_FIELD:4 */ 
  (*(regp) = (*(regp) & ~(name ## _ ## field ## _MASK)) \
             | ((value) << name ## _ ## field ## _SH))
